name: The sandbox, from the card
title: The sandbox, from the card
story: The camera dives into a running card on the board. The card becomes a cell with a dashed wall, the agent inside. Rays toward the internet, the host and the cloud metadata stop at the wall and ripple. One pipe leads out to the model gateway, whose ring gauge fills with each call, held then booked. A push token bounces off the wall. At the cap the gauge turns amber and the factory asks: fund it or end it. The cell collapses, one push reaches the repository, and the camera pulls back to the board.
